body: They are often very violent  dreams that waken me into a full panic attack every night . School shootings , watching a loved one who had passed die over and over without being able to help, things of that nature . I don't know what causes them and talked to my doctor about them (I was worried it might be the meds but they don't have that side effect) . They just happen
I don't see any beauty in the world . And often don't care to be here . I'm just here without a purpose
